scientific_integrity: The coherent-state threshold is credited to the motivating source. Exact compact singular spectrum and endpoint continuous model follow from separate analytic Gaussian identities; finite checks do not establish infinite-dimensional completeness.
scientific_limitations: Real s,t, t>0, s²>t²+1, radial Gaussian symbols, Hilbert Fock only; source Proposition 14 previously identifies the coherent-state threshold; no general complex-parameter or non-Hilbert extension claimed. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact Gaussian-symbol spectral transition for two-parameter Fock operators
